summary: Enhance your skills with our Performance Appraisal and Evaluation Systems Training Course in LOCATION.
lede: Performance appraisal training helps managers, supervisors, and HR professionals set expectations and assess staff contributions. It covers defining objectives and KPIs, selecting rating criteria, gathering evidence, and conducting review conversations with constructive feedback. Participants also learn to address rating bias and underperformance, and connect appraisal outcomes with development and reward decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly evaluate staff performance, provide feedback, or make decisions based on appraisal outcomes.
modules: Foundations of Performance Management and Appraisal
Rating Scales, Competencies, and Evaluation Criteria
Managing Underperformance and Performance Improvement Plans
Biases, Fairness, and Legal Considerations in Appraisal
Linking Appraisal to Rewards, Development, and Talent Decisions
Digital Performance Management and Continuous Feedback Systems
Monitoring, Evaluating, and Improving the Appraisal System
prerequisites: This course requires participants to have basic managerial experience in leading teams or projects and be familiar with organizational performance metrics. A background in HR or previous experience with performance appraisals is beneficial but not mandatory.
